Article 26 of the Constitution provides that subject to public order,

· c0nfounded with cultus of form or worship o(a particular
sect, but is distinguishable from the latter".. We do not
· think that the above definition can be regarded as either
precise or adequate. Articles 25 aud 26 of our Consti•
tution are based for the most part ·upon article 44(2) · of
the Constitution of Eire and we have great doubt .whether
